manaNeeded: {0} plus the mana cost of the creature in your hand
easyPrerequisites: Phantom Steed must be exiled by Lagrella, and Fiend Hunter must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Fiend Hunter for its mana cost.
When Fiend Hunter enters, it exiles Lagrella until Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Fiend Hunter's ETB.
When Lagrella leaves the battlefield, Phantom Steed is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Phantom Steed enters, it exiles Fiend Hunter until Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Phantom Steed's ETB.
When Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield, Lagrella is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Lagrella enters, it exiles Phantom Steed until Lagrella leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Lagrella's ETB.
When Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield, Fiend Hunter is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
